scientific_limitations: Only centered positive-definite three-dimensional ellipsoids and the inradius-normalized common offset interval.
Relative optimal product approximation under uniform angular and offset probability measures, not every tomography noise model.
No global inverse bound for geometric eccentricity: the oblate family makes the rank-one defect tend to zero.

title: Sharp rank-one section-profile defect of ellipsoids and opposite high-eccentricity limits
